headline: GIFT Nifty signals strong Tuesday start following Reliance-led rally and lower oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong Q2 earnings from Reliance Industries powered a significant market rally
GIFT Nifty jumped 200 points signaling a strong gap-up start for Tuesday
A decline in global oil prices boosted sentiment across Indian indices
Positive global cues and heavy buying led Sensex and Nifty to gain over 1% each
whatHappening: A fire broke out at an HPCL facility in Visakhapatnam with no reported casualties
Thomas Cook India reported a 24% fall in Q2 net profit due to dipping revenue
ITC and NALCO reported contracting margins and profit dips in their latest quarterly results
Cyclone Murasu is approaching the Andhra coast as a severe cyclonic storm
summary: Indian markets are poised for a strong opening as GIFT Nifty signals a 200-point gap-up following a massive rally led by Reliance's robust earnings. While the benchmark indices reclaimed key levels, several major firms like ITC and Thomas Cook reported weak Q2 results. Investors are also tracking the impact of Cyclone Murasu and a fire incident at HPCL's Vizag facility.
